topic.title: Cold Plate Width and Turbo Response

body.p: 1 Analysis assumes fan running at full speed and these curves are exemplary and are not intended to represent any one Intel product.

Increasing the width of the cold plate can slightly increase the time that the SoC can operate in full turbo power (PL2) prior to reaching. This additional headroom can also be used to increase PL2 power for a targeted duration (Power Capability) to optimize for specific workloads. Intel recommends full PL2 power support for ≥ 3 to 5 seconds to meet target performance. .
